procedural_matters: The Race Committee was represented by Konrad Sagebiel.
GER 281 was represented by Johann Sach.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 18 knots of wind and a small chop.
GER 281 was approaching the finish pin mark on port tack below the layline.
While dropping her spinnaker GER 281 capsized on top of the mark.
After righting her boat, GER 281 was below the mark, sailed on starboard tack until she cleared the mark, tacked onto port and crossed the finish line.
GER 281 did not take a penalty before finishing.
After finishing, GER 281 realized she had not taken a penalty but took no additional action.
conclusions: GER 281 touched the finish pin mark and broke RRS 31.

By knowingly breaking RRS 31 and not taking the appropriate penalty, GER 281 failed to compete in compliance with the principles of sportsmanship and fair play as stated in Basic Principles and required by RRS 2. GER 281 broke RRS 2.
decision: GER 281 is disqualified in race Q5, such disqualification is not excludable.
